name: review
title: 리뷰만
use: Review only, no edits: read the context of a diff or branch, report findings, keep only those that survive disproof.
rules:
Follow AGENTS.md in the repo.
Never commit or push.

stages.title: 맥락 파악
stages.task: Read the change and its purpose. Summarise what it does and which files matter. Change nothing.

stages.title: 리뷰-확인
stages.task: Try to disprove each 리뷰 finding against the code, git blame and git log -L. Report only confirmed findings ranked by severity, plus one line per finding: id, rule, verdict (confirmed|disproved|pre-existing). Change nothing.
